description: This Java class provides utility methods for formatting dates, numbers, percentages, and exceptions within the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It includes methods for formatting Date objects into locale-specific strings with different levels of detail (date, time, timestamp), as well as formatting percentages and exceptions for logging. It leverages Java's DateFormat and NumberFormat classes, and references the OpenMRS Context for locale information.
